content.title: Review recent activity status pill rendering
content.intent: Prove visible recent-activity statuses are rendered as compact pill-style labels.
content.technique_notes: Direct source-path decomposition from the Status presentation rule. Negative, boundary, and combinatorial techniques were not applicable because the source stated a single presentation promise and no editable inputs or alternate outcomes. Budget estimate: 1 scenario/test pair for this path, within the max_pairs ceiling of 8.
